original_failures_and_fixes.failure: Live journal retained 1000 rows against a 200-row window; console retained oversized Unicode history.
A late journal snapshot replaced a newer live sequence.
Storage report JSON and operating-system exceptions disclosed private cache paths.
A 10000-event burst queued 10000 agent refreshes; the fixed implementation queues one.

limitations: One Apple Silicon laptop; no native Windows, Intel Mac or Linux resource acceptance.
Short sleeping processes do not model provider model memory, heavy output, file churn, sustained sessions or soaks.
GUI interval CPU at 100 quiet agents was about 5.2% of one core; measured tuning and longer baselines remain open.
Summed RSS is not unique physical memory. GUI queue and scrollback bounds do not establish a total RAM ceiling.
Terminal input queue and protocol frame byte bounds require follow-up.
The earlier packaged GUI capture timeout remains unresolved; this later pass does not establish its cause.
No signing/notarization, distinct-source upgrade or live daemon handoff acceptance.
Newer main Homebrew changes and PR #77 were not part of this candidate. Final CI and CodeRabbit review remain pending.
